description: compilationHash as implemented in backend/jewelmind/compilation/identity.py and used as the ModelService cache key. Every value below was produced by running that code against the checked-in JDL examples and the environment this repository is tested in. See docs/bible/08-alchemist/175-definition-hash-vs-compilation-hash.md and docs/bible/03-decisions/ADR-012-compilation-hash-as-cache-key.md.
formula: sha256(f'{definitionHash}|{compilerVersion}|{geometryGeneratorVersion}|{forgeRuleSetVersion}|{kernelVersion}|{ocpVersion}').hexdigest()[:16] - the same truncation scheme as definition_hash(), not a new hashing convention. An unreadable ocpVersion is hashed as the literal 'absent' rather than omitted, so a shorter input cannot collide with a build named for the placeholder.

excludedComponents.jdlSchemaVersion: already inside definitionHash, since schemaVersion is a field of the document
excludedComponents.inspectionVersion: Geometry Inspection is read-only by contract (INSPECT-GOV-013); including it would discard correct cached geometry for a change that cannot affect geometry

environmentNote: kernelVersion and ocpVersion are the versions installed in this environment. A different CadQuery/OpenCascade build legitimately produces different compilationHash values for the same design - that is the entire purpose of the identifier - so these vectors are verified by RECOMPUTING from the recorded components, never by pinning a hash to a particular machine.

vectors.note: A different definitionHash yields a different compilationHash, as expected.

Same definitionHash, different compilerVersion, different compilationHash - the entire point of a separate identity: it changes when any output-affecting version changes, even though design intent did not.

Same definitionHash, different kernelVersion, different compilationHash. Sprint 5's CI proved two OCCT builds produce different volumes for one design, so this is the component empirically shown to matter.

doNotSilentlyReplaceDefinitionHash: definitionHash (backend/jewelmind/utils/hashing.py::definition_hash()) is unchanged and remains the identity of canonical design intent. compilationHash was added beside it; ModelRecord carries both as separate fields so neither can stand in for the other.
